_doc: Which artifacts get how much tone/style attention from the critic persona and the watcher. First matching rule wins. Tiers set by the user verbatim, 2026-07-16 (session gcc-drift-3e). Consumed by personas/readers-advocate.md and the style-watch stack.

tiers.heavy: full thesaurus enforcement: prose + structure + vocab digests, harsh on extraneous words, WHY/WHAT chain required on findings
tiers.medium: understandability without being boring: flair allowed, structure + clarity enforced, wordiness flagged only when it obscures
tiers.comment-minimal: comments only: minimum word count; never convey the WHAT; payload is the non-obvious WHY/HOW; one line unless a docstring contract
tiers.off: no tone enforcement; agent writes however it outputs

rules.note: user: 'My versable projects need it HEAVILY'
reports shown to the user or filed as a 'main' thing; includes assets/reports/** and .claude/output/** report deliverables
user: claude-owned projects mostly exempt, 'but for their README.md / USAGE.md / MIGRATION.md / GUIDEBOOK.md, I absolutely care'
user: 'absolutely needs to be tone curated'; synthesis prompt derives tone from thesaurus digest, never from intermediate artifacts
user: 'however the agent outputs them' — unless they would inform the final report's tone
user: 'can have some flair but understandability without being boring'
user: 'Projects where claude owns it mostly, I really don't care' (doc exceptions matched above)
